# CmisVcs10RxOutputEqCode — CMIS-VCS 1.0 Rx Output Equalization Code

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisVcs10RxOutputEqCode`
- Description: Code values of the OutputEqPreCursorTargetRx&lt;i&gt; and OutputEqPostCursorTargetRx&lt;i&gt; registers (VCS Parameter ID 07h), OIF-CMIS-VCS-01.0 § 5.9 Table 5-18. Post-cursor codes step 1 dB per code; pre-cursor codes step 0.5 dB per code (Equations 5-1 and 5-2 relate the dB settings to equalizer coefficients Cn). Codes 8 to 10 are reserved, 11 to 15 custom.
